mapper.sql: id, task_id, directory_path, final_directory_path, media_type, tmdb_id, rename_media, status, stage, progress, message, error_message, rename_plan, rename_operation_index, renamed_directory_count, renamed_file_count, uploaded_files, created_at, started_at, completed_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO manual_scraping_job (task_id, directory_path, final_directory_path, media_type, tmdb_id, rename_media, status, stage, progress, message, rename_plan, rename_operation_index, renamed_directory_count, renamed_file_count, uploaded_files) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{directoryPath}, #{finalDirectoryPath}, #{mediaType}, #{tmdbId}, #{renameMedia}, #{status}, #{stage}, #{progress}, #{message}, #{renamePlan}, #{renameOperationIndex}, #{renamedDirectoryCount}, #{renamedFileCount}, #{uploadedFiles})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM manual_scraping_job WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM manual_scraping_job WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE manual_scraping_job SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = COALESCE(started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE manual_scraping_job SET status = #{status}, stage = #{stage}, progress = #{progress}, message = #{message}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, final_directory_path = #{finalDirectoryPath}, rename_plan = #{renamePlan}, rename_operation_index = #{renameOperationIndex}, renamed_directory_count = #{renamedDirectoryCount}, renamed_file_count = #{renamedFileCount}, uploaded_files = #{uploadedFiles}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE manual_scraping_job SET status = 'PENDING', progress = CASE WHEN progress >= 100 THEN 95 ELSE progress END, message = '等待重试', error_message = NULL, completed_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FAILED'

UPDATE manual_scraping_job SET status = 'FAILED', message = '应用重启导致作业中断，可从当前阶段重试', error_message = '应用在作业完成前重启', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
